acceptance.requirement: Reproducibly generate valid and explicitly invalid fixtures with generator/input identities, handwritten expectations and independent oracle provenance.
acceptance.scope: Two complete deterministic generations; handwritten bounded parser checks distinct from generator and production reader; exact component/header/map/structure claims only, not ART executability.

acceptance.requirement: MUTF-8 NUL/surrogates, ULEB/SLEB overflow, identical local IDs across DEX occurrences, repeated calls, no body, payload and try/catch counterexamples.
acceptance.scope: Native code_off=0 differs from body-bearing methods; invoke sites retain PCs 0/3; packed/sparse/array payload component vectors and catch-all code layout are explicit. 512 independent fifth-byte LEB boundary checks supplement handwritten values.

acceptance.requirement: Distinguish invalid input, unknown format, incomplete facts and normal empty scope; do not infer 036/041 support from numeric ranges.
acceptance.scope: Exact-version positive headers, unsupported 036/041 magic discrimination, concrete malformed errors, explicit zero-table header/map scope and unbuilt-fact outcome expectations. Production result envelope execution is a later task.

acceptance.requirement: Metamorphic cases for input order, logical duplicates, member renaming, same-size/same-mtime changes and semantics-preserving reordering.
acceptance.scope: Actually executed. Legal independent class_defs reorder changes class_def_idx; string_data/class_data layouts reverse and offsets relocate. Every encoded string/type/proto/method/class-data reference in the pair is validated; complete normalized two-class/two-method semantics equal while physical SHA/IDs differ.

acceptance.requirement: Independent oracle does not reuse production core; synthetic DEX/APK is not described as installable Android software.
acceptance.scope: Checker imports no production reader or generator. Python ZIP writer/checker common ancestry is disclosed. APK installability/signatures and external full verifier qualification are not claimed.

qualification_limit: MDD-004 is a preparatory fixture/oracle/validation-plan task. Completing it unlocks implementation dependencies but grants no parser, SQL, HostLab, platform or performance release qualification.
